using CUDA
import Pkg
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "JACC") || Pkg.add(name = "JACC", version = "1")
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "Atomix") || Pkg.add("Atomix")
import JACC
import Atomix
JACC.@init_backend

using JSON3

function initstacks_sumsq_shifted_b()
    return nothing
end

function sumsq_shifted_b(loss, lossb, u, ub, alpha, alphab, beta, betab, i_n)
    for i_seq_x = 1:i_n
        loss[1] = loss[1] + (alpha * u[i_seq_x] + beta) ^ 2
    end
    for i_seq_x = i_n:-1:1
        alphab = alphab + u[i_seq_x] * ((2 * (alpha * u[i_seq_x] + beta)) * lossb[1])
        ub[i_seq_x] = ub[i_seq_x] + alpha * ((2 * (alpha * u[i_seq_x] + beta)) * lossb[1])
        betab = betab + (2 * (alpha * u[i_seq_x] + beta)) * lossb[1]
    end
    return (alphab, betab)
end

function initstacks_sumsq_shifted_b_jacc()
    return nothing
end

function sumsq_shifted_b_jacc(loss, lossb, u, ub, alpha, alphab, beta, betab, i_n)
    alphab = JACC.array([alphab])
    betab = JACC.array([betab])
    JACC.@parallel_for range = div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1 jacc_kernel_sumsq_shifted_b_1!(alpha, beta, i_n, loss, u)
    JACC.@parallel_for range = div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1 jacc_kernel_sumsq_shifted_b_2!(alpha, alphab, beta, betab, i_n, lossb, u, ub)
    alphab = (JACC.to_host(alphab))[1]
    betab = (JACC.to_host(betab))[1]
    return (alphab, betab)
end

function jacc_kernel_sumsq_shifted_b_1!(__jacc_i, alpha, beta, i_n, loss, u)
    i_seq_x = 1 + (__jacc_i - 1)
    Atomix.@atomic loss[1] += (alpha * u[i_seq_x] + beta) ^ 2
    return nothing
end

function jacc_kernel_sumsq_shifted_b_2!(__jacc_i, alpha, alphab, beta, betab, i_n, lossb, u, ub)
    i_seq_x = i_n + (__jacc_i - 1) * -1
    Atomix.@atomic alphab[1] += u[i_seq_x] * ((2 * (alpha * u[i_seq_x] + beta)) * lossb[1])
    ub[i_seq_x] = ub[i_seq_x] + alpha * ((2 * (alpha * u[i_seq_x] + beta)) * lossb[1])
    Atomix.@atomic betab[1] += (2 * (alpha * u[i_seq_x] + beta)) * lossb[1]
    return nothing
end

function _val_init_stacks_local(fn, extra_args)
    r = fn(extra_args...)
    r === nothing && return ()
    r isa Tuple && return r
    return (r,)
end

_relerr_scalar(a, b) = abs(a - b) / max(abs(a), abs(b), 1.0)
_relerr_arr(a, b) = maximum(abs.(a .- b) ./ max.(abs.(a), abs.(b), 1.0))

i_n = 2
__base_loss = Float64[1.0559676194046643, -1.7386903045507713, 1.2483486406194497, -1.3620124824340132]
__base_u = Float64[-0.24943579003392274, -1.311898050748365, 0.9018280547902268, -0.6988786616910534]
__base_alpha = 0.46184399542828797
__base_beta = 0.9654550655261834
__seed_alpha = [-0.6302568528632938, 1.1859406847593357, 0.45340366688127937]
__seed_beta = [0.15218048777037568, 3.059795043621311, 1.2609033132203464]
__seed_loss = [Float64[0.2364838923418031, 0.5689662939295573, -0.7152139267578203, -0.46760475641687654], Float64[-0.6544621477220274, 0.56088578253173, 1.3475816560265546, 1.377745483742238], Float64[0.12413890652773037, 1.6624448750682808, 0.7518841347786288, -1.3530729802328434]]
__seed_u = [Float64[-0.11835937942441493, 0.2684706248051184, 1.861652699060422, 2.289826071480206], Float64[0.8816686226306508, -0.5350209918217954, -2.3929586073256583, -1.3905063391589632], Float64[-1.1096965165237374, 0.895488886481405, 0.5368778120559803, -0.11268015156732375]]
max_rel_err = 0.0
for __trial in 1:3
  loss_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_loss); loss_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial])
  loss_val_gpu = JACC.array(deepcopy(__base_loss)); loss_sh_gpu = JACC.array(deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial]))
  u_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_u); u_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_u[__trial])
  u_val_gpu = JACC.array(deepcopy(__base_u)); u_sh_gpu = JACC.array(deepcopy(__seed_u[__trial]))
  alpha_val_cpu = __base_alpha; alpha_sh_cpu = __seed_alpha[__trial]
  alpha_val_gpu = __base_alpha; alpha_sh_gpu = __seed_alpha[__trial]
  beta_val_cpu = __base_beta; beta_sh_cpu = __seed_beta[__trial]
  beta_val_gpu = __base_beta; beta_sh_gpu = __seed_beta[__trial]
  stacks_cpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_sumsq_shifted_b, Any[])
  stacks_gpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_sumsq_shifted_b_jacc, Any[])
  ret_cpu = sumsq_shifted_b(loss_val_cpu, loss_sh_cpu, u_val_cpu, u_sh_cpu, alpha_val_cpu, alpha_sh_cpu, beta_val_cpu, beta_sh_cpu, i_n, stacks_cpu...)
  ret_gpu = sumsq_shifted_b_jacc(loss_val_gpu, loss_sh_gpu, u_val_gpu, u_sh_gpu, alpha_val_gpu, alpha_sh_gpu, beta_val_gpu, beta_sh_gpu, i_n, stacks_gpu...)
  ret_cpu_t = ret_cpu
  ret_gpu_t = ret_gpu
  local_max = 0.0
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_sh_cpu, Array(loss_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_val_cpu, Array(loss_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(u_sh_cpu, Array(u_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(u_val_cpu, Array(u_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_scalar(ret_cpu_t[1], ret_gpu_t[1]))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_scalar(ret_cpu_t[2], ret_gpu_t[2]))
  global max_rel_err = max(max_rel_err, local_max)
end
println(JSON3.write(Dict("ok" => max_rel_err <= 7.500000000000001e-14, "max_rel_err" => max_rel_err, "device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())))))
